svg.title: Four Ways to Read the Same Review
svg.desc: One hotel review, "Staff in Seattle were lovely, but parking was awful and check-in was slow", goes through four text analysis techniques. Entity recognition (NER) returns typed items: Seattle is a Location. Key phrase extraction returns untyped topics: slow check-in, parking, staff. Sentiment analysis gives positive, neutral or negative with scores, and opinion mining ties it to aspects: staff positive, parking negative. Summarization is extractive, picking original sentences, or abstractive, writing new ones. Language detection and PII detection sit alongside.
svg.text: Four Ways to Read the Same Review
Entities are typed, key phrases aren't, sentiment has a polarity, summaries are extracted or written.
"Staff in Seattle were lovely, but parking was awful and check-in was slow."
Language detection and PII detection sit alongside. In Azure Language, key phrases, sentiment and
summarization are legacy (retiring 2029); NER, PII and language detection stay core.
